title: Pact of the Chain: accept the imp/pseudodragon/quasit/sprite familiar forms (needs pact-boon persistence + curated form grant)
description:
Split from eshyra-qxnc (2026-10-07). feature:warlock:pact-boon option pact-boon:pact-of-the-chain (SRD 5.1 p. 47): "When you cast the spell, you can choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite." The creature records creature:imp, creature:pseudodragon, creature:quasit and creature:sprite exist. recast_bonded_summon only accepts spell:find-familiar creation.forms, so a chain warlock cannot restore or reform a familiar as, or into, a special form. That refuses legal SRD play.

BLOCKED ON TWO MISSING PIECES:
(a) The engine never records a character's chosen pact boon. levelUpEngine classifies 'pact-boon' as an unsupported 'class-feature-choice' and blocks the level-up, and no bead owns applying it.
(b) The pack carries the form extension only as option prose. The pact-boon mechanics hold just spellGrants: spell:find-familiar. A curated structured extension is needed (e.g. a familiar-form grant on the option that names the four creature refs), under docs/importer-fix-protocol.md and the compiler protocols.
Then recast_bonded_summon (and any creation-time form validation) must accept the extended forms only when the bond's caster (the effect's source actor, durable after eshyra-qxnc) has Pact of the Chain. Its Attack-action clause ("forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its reaction") also sits against the familiar's cannot-attack modification. Design that interaction too.
notes:
2026-10-08: blocker (a) is now owned by eshyra-ug4i (level-up accepts and persists class-feature choices incl. pact boon); dependency wired. Blocker (b), the curated familiar-form grant on pact-boon:pact-of-the-chain, stays in this bead.
2026-10-08 (Claude Captain reconciliation): blocker (a) is DONE — eshyra-ug4i.3 (PR #609, merge 03a7c4d9) persists the chosen pact boon on CharacterSheet.featureChoices (feature:warlock:pact-boon, option pact-boon:pact-of-the-chain). The dependency on the whole eshyra-ug4i epic was stale (its only open child, ug4i.1 expertise, is irrelevant here) and is replaced by a dependency on the closed eshyra-ug4i.3. Remaining scope unchanged: (b) curated structured familiar-form grant for imp/pseudodragon/quasit/sprite under docs/importer-fix-protocol.md; recast/creation form validation gated on the bond caster's recorded Pact of the Chain; and the design of the Attack-action 'forgo one attack so the familiar attacks with its reaction' clause against the familiar's cannot-attack modification.
PR opened 2026-10-09; supervisor reviewed, reclassified the 3 inventory rows as complete, verify green. Stays in_progress until merge.
